prompt: Some people work harder than other. Why is this? Is this a positive or negative habit?
essay:
Some people tend to work harder than others, although working hard can bring about several benefits, I personally believe that it  may be negative when people work excessively and neglect other important things in life.

The first reason why some people work harder than others is their strong ambition and desire for financial independence. People who want to earn more money or achieve a higher career position spend extra time and effort on their job. In addition, some people  are naturally ambitious and disciplined, meaning that their respect and love for work will be greater than that of others. For instance, people who want to become a manager may work harder, develop new skills in order to achieve the advance their career.

In my view, if it is in moderation, working hard may be a positive habit. Hard-working people can develop valuable skills, achieve a higher career position, and achieve their dreams. However, working excessively can have some serious drawbacks because it may lead to stress and exhaustion. working harder can negative impact on the relationships of their families, since they have limited opportunities to spend time with their families. Therefore, working harder should be encouraged, but people should also maintain their life balance between their life and work experience in order to strengthen their relationships with their families and achieve mental relaxation.

In conclusion, although excessive work can lead to financial and professional benefits, I firmly believe that working excessively can lead to some serious health issues, such as stress and exhaustion. Therefore, it should be in moderation.
